items.stance: Voted against an earlier, narrower version of, and did not vote on the final passage of,

items.text: Introduced, as one of its two lead sponsors, a bill ending required immigration detention, phasing out privately run detention centers and the use of jails within three years, presuming release for most people awaiting a decision, and ending the detention of families with children. 122 other legislators cosponsored it.

Reintroduced, as one of its lead sponsors, a bill giving people brought to the country as children, and holders of temporary protection from removal, permanent residence and a path to citizenship. An independent estimate of an identical earlier version put those potentially eligible at up to about 4.4 million people, about 1.3 percent of the population.
